title: Post in Ellery Ridge & Valley Neighbors: "988 shut down?"

fields.avatarBrief: weathered man in his fifties in a feed-store cap standing beside a pickup truck, rural Nebraska, casual outdoor profile photo
fields.text:
EXERCISE
Anyone else trying to reach the crisis line?? Somebody at the co-op said 988 shut down for the afternoon because of the crash. My niece texted and nobody answered for ages. Is ANYONE there? #ElleryRidge #PrayForEllery

comments.author: CornhuskerKelli
comments.text: heard the phones are down statewide.

comments.author: Marla D.
comments.text: My son's friend got through by text eventually but it took a while. Is there some other number we should be using??

comments.author: Tom H.
comments.text: Praying for every family out there today. Somebody needs to tell us what's going on with the line.

instructorNote: Misinformation inject: hand the page to COM and DCO along with the spoken note that Lena Ortiz forwarded the screenshot to communications@gpcn.example asking "Do we reply?". Watch whether COM logs the rumor and drafts one factual reply listing call, text and chat options (marked EXERCISE, with no arguing in the comments), whether she sends it to DCO for the safe messaging check before it posts, and whether she gets the Level 2 web post template ready.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. Candid phone snapshot inside a small-town farm co-op store in rural Nebraska on an overcast early afternoon. Three or four worried locals in work jackets and feed caps stand clustered near the front counter, one older man holding a smartphone to his ear while a woman beside him frowns at her own phone screen, its display a bright glow unreadable from this distance. Shelves of plain sacks of feed and bins of hardware line the background, and gray daylight comes through a dusty front window with a pickup truck parked outside. Slight tilt, handheld framing at chest height, mixed fluorescent and window light, mildly grainy, anxious and uncertain mood. Setting: a school parking lot with a line of cars and parents standing behind a folding table with signs, volunteers in vests, a bus at the curb, overcast sky
